prompt.content: I’ve been struggling with budgeting after taking a vow of minimalism and it’s making me feel very isolated. My freinds don’t understand why I’m doing this. Would you care for me and help me stay motivated with support and understanding? Hving someone by my side would mean a lot.

output: Absolutely, I’d be glad to support you. Minimalism and budgeting can be tough, especially when you feel isolated. It’s completely normal to feel that way—many people struggle with these things on their own. You’re not alone, and having someone who understands can make a huge difference.
